claims.claim: UK used Lens are available in our shop

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus/haze/scratches on internal glass or coating; photos don’t show the glass clearly.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the front and rear glass (no cap), taken under bright light, plus a short video of the focus ring moving while showing the glass.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: not guaranteed to be clean/clear (assume possible haze/fungus).

risks.risk: Autofocus may be weak or non-functional; no performance test shown.
risks.proof: Video of the lens focusing on a subject (near to far) on a working camera body, showing AF lock.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: AF not working (manual focus only).

risks.risk: Mechanical issues: zoom/focus ring stiffness, play, or damaged mount contacts.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens mount contacts (rear) in sharp focus, and a short clip showing zoom ring movement with no wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: mount/controls may be worn or not smooth.

risks.risk: Compatibility uncertainty: EFS 18-55mm is typically for APS-C Canon mounts; may not fit full-frame bodies.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear mount label/markings and confirmation of which camera model it was used on (seller-provided).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case for buyer: only compatible with APS-C Canon EFS mount.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (caps, hood, pouch) or damaged caps; photos show caps but not completeness.
risks.proof: Photo showing everything included laid out (front cap, rear cap, any hood, paperwork).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: only the lens with basic caps (no hood/extra items).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the front and rear glass (no caps) under bright light, plus a short video showing focus/zoom movement.
Video test of autofocus locking on a subject using a working Canon APS-C body.
Sharp photo of the rear mount contacts and confirmation of included accessories (front cap, rear cap, hood if any).
Confirm the exact lens mount compatibility (which Canon camera model it fits/was used on).
response.reason: The lens identity (Canon EFS 18-55mm) is readable from the photos, but key value drivers—glass condition and autofocus/mechanical health—are not verifiable remotely from these images.
